Hi thrilled to work with you, 
Yes for now we are mainly focused on EVM RPCs that are dedicated for developers or traders, where they have more customizability and not bound to the strict rate limits some other providers provide that kind of our MVP. 

BUT we have much more planned, once we have the runway, we intend to support one click staking, and fractionalize staking pools so that our users can earn rewards on validator nodes.

List all multi-winner voting systems (other than Sortition and Random Ballot) that only passes/satisfies each of all of the following five (5) criteria:
1. uses a score/range type ballot
2. proportional representation
3. the 'no favorite betrayal' criterion
4. the 'independence of (irrelevant) clones' criterion, and
5. it passes all the other four (4) criteria in a 'party-agnostic' election (where voters would vote for individual candidates, not party lists, and those individual candidates are elected independently of party affiliations if the candidates have any.

If the voting system that satisfies all of the five (5) said criteria does not yet exist, devise a new voting system that satisfies/passes each of all the five (5) said criteria.

I am making a startup focused on producing software solutions for wind farm (and potentially turbine control too) for control solutions based on short term wind forecasting in wind farm context using AI , in particular complex transformer models, for power optimization (though could be extended for grid optimisation in the future too). We are thinking of a name. Initially thought of ZephyrAI but it's taken by a completely unrelated company. Thinking that our potential clients would be already established big wind farm suppliers, controllers, owners or manufacturer companies and not individuals, how should we name it ? Also thinking on potential domain names for website (.ai? .com?) . Think deeply about this and offer and thoughtful insight with ideas about potential good names with explanations.

Global mnc hq directed singapore users to manually move their files on their laptops from their local drive into microsoft onedrive . for our pst files, they directed us  to manually mount our psts in outlook and use  outlook import function to import our pst files to exchange online. Both of these were global hq's idea.

I am just a low level engineer who suggested  to global hq to use microsoft onedrive known folder move to automate the syncing of files to Microsoft onedrive which global hq told me that my idea was a bad idea which they stated users can face multiple sync errors. i then fought back to global hq that we can mitigate these sync errors using the existing tellris dlp to move unsupported filetypes out  which can easily support my recommendation to use known folder move.

For outlook pst files upload to Microsoft exchange online i proposed using network upload method.

Is global hq correct or me ?

Without doubt, paper cutting is my favourite Chinese traditional culture. it is a skill that i take pride in.
last year, i went to visit my grandma in the countryside. she liked paper cutting very much and lots of shapes were shown on the wall. i liked them so i asked my grandma to teach me how to make them. she taught me very patiently. after a few weeks, i could also cut some beautiful shapes. after a few weeks, i could also cut some beautiful shapes. after that, whenever the spring festival comes, i always make some paper cuttings for my friends and neighbors. i pass on this Chinese culture to many people and i was very glad to do that.
in my opinion, teenagers should also spread the Chinese traditional culture. they can learn some skills from their grandparents and spread them to more people. 请根据任务及要求优化这篇文章英语课上为了培养学生的文化自信并思考文化传承的重要性，老师组织的主题为side by side in spreading culture的演讲比赛，请写一篇演讲稿参加比赛.内容包括what's your favorite Chinese traditional culture? how did you carry forward it? what do you expect tanagers around you to do. 100词左右
